subject: Private Deployment Operational Safeguards — Capability Matrix and Evidence Request
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@astramed.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@astramed.com
Date: 2028-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AstraMed RFP: private deployment controls & evidence request

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the introductory call last week. AstraMed's security and procurement teams have pulled together a short list of controls and evidence we'll need to validate vendor readiness for our on-prem/private deployments. We've attached our questionnaire and would appreciate your capability mapping and any supporting artifacts you can share (network diagrams, operator runbook excerpts, KMS boundary notes).

Key must-haves for our compliance board:
- Network egress controls and proof of configurable egress rules
- Operator separation (no commingling of AstraMed keys or data with other customers)
- KMS integration options (HSM/KMS and rotation procedures)
- Patch signing and SBOM for offline updates
- Audit logging and evidence retention windows (S3/secure on-prem storage)

Can you confirm a target date for a written response and any artifacts? We're aiming to close the security gate by 10/10 to hit our pilot timeline.

Best,
Emma Li
Senior Vendor Analyst — AstraMed Systems
emma.li@astramed.com
AstraMed RFP packet attached: astramed_q_control_list_v3.xlsx

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@astramed.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AstraMed RFP: private deployment controls & evidence request

Emma —

Appreciate the detailed list. We're able to provide a capability matrix and artifacts for the items you outlined. Quick summary upfront:

- Network egress: configurable per-deployment egress policies, per-subnet egress firewall rules, and optional airgap mode with delayed media transfer.
- Operator separation: dedicated tenant isolation for private deployments, role-based operator accounts, and configurable operator scoping.
- KMS/HSM: support for external KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSM via PKCS#11), plus automated rotation hooks.
- Patch/SBOM: signed patch process and SBOM export for every release; offline patching workflow documented.
- Audit logs: per-tenant, tamper-evident logs with configurable retention; can export to customer-managed storage.

I'll attach an initial capability matrix and a network diagram excerpt. Monica (security lead) and Ben (solutions) are on copy to add technical depth where needed.

We should be able to return a complete packet by 2028-09-27. Does that fit your timeline? If you'd like, we can schedule a short walkthrough on the 28th to walk the controls and attachments.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Attachment stubs: astramed_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx; private_deploy_network_diagram.pdf

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: AstraMed RFP: private deployment controls & evidence request

Quick internal notes for the packet I'm preparing:

- Network egress: include explicit examples for iptables/sg rules and the admin UI toggles for "deny-by-default" and explicit allow lists; note that airgap mode disables external image pulls.
- Operator separation: attach the operator role JSON and a short narrative on how we use namespace isolation plus encryption-at-rest keys per-tenant.
- KMS: add our HSM integration test summary (customer-managed PKCS#11) and example KMS policy for key rotation.
- Patch/SBOM: include a signed SBOM sample and offline patch checklist (operator-runbook excerpt).
- Logging: provide sample log export manifest and retention config snippet for 7/30/90/365 day buckets.

I'll draft the technical answers and hand off to Ben for the diagrams. Naomi, can you pull the SBOM and signed-patch proof from the release vault?

-Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Emma Li <emma.li@astramed.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@astramed.com
Date: 2028-09-22T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AstraMed RFP: private deployment controls & evidence request

Thanks — the timeline works for us. A couple of clarifications from the compliance board so we can evaluate artifacts more efficiently:

1) For the operator separation requirement, do you have an example access matrix showing which operator roles can perform system-level actions versus customer-scoped actions? A simple CSV is fine.
2) For KMS, is it possible to show an example of key rotation performed while the service is offline (i.e., in an airgapped site) and any manual steps required?
3) For audit logs, we need assurance that logs can be exported to a customer-owned SFTP endpoint in addition to object storage.

If you can address those three items in the packet, we'll be able to move to narrative review immediately.

Emma

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@astramed.com>
Cc: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-25T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: AstraMed RFP: private deployment controls & evidence request

Hi Emma — attaching the handoff set. Highlights responding to your clarifications:

- Operator access matrix: included as operator_access_matrix.csv (sample shows Admin, PlatformOps, CustomerSupport roles and permitted actions).
- Offline KMS rotation: attached operator_runbook_excerpt.txt with step-by-step rotation when the host is airgapped; includes KMS re-wrap commands and manual key import notes.
- Log export: we support pushing to customer SFTP endpoints using a signed-transfer agent; details in network_diagram page 2 and the export_manifest.json sample.

Attachments included in packet: astramed_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx; private_deploy_network_diagram.pdf; operator_runbook_excerpt.txt; operator_access_matrix.csv; sbom_signed_sample.json

I'll also include a short recorded walkthrough link after internal review. Can we set a 30-minute review slot on 2028-09-28 10:00 PT?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@astramed.com>, procurement@astramed.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-27T15:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AstraMed RFP: private deployment controls & evidence request

Emma —

Packet delivered per timeline. Summary of included artifacts and quick guidance for reviewers:

- Capability matrix (astramed_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx): concise mapping versus AstraMed asks.
- Network diagram (private_deploy_network_diagram.pdf): shows egress control points, SFTP export path, and airgap toggle.
- Operator runbook excerpt (operator_runbook_excerpt.txt): offline patch and KMS rotation procedures.
- Operator access matrix (operator_access_matrix.csv): role-to-action mapping — redactions applied for sensitive internal tooling names.
- SBOM signed sample (sbom_signed_sample.json): demonstrates reproducible SBOM + signature.

If AstraMed would like an RSA-signed attestation on the SBOM or a short live demo of the KMS rotation steps in a sandbox, we can arrange that in the follow-up call. Confirming the 2028-09-28 10:00 PT slot works for our team; invite sent.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Attachments: astramed_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx; private_deploy_network_diagram.pdf; operator_runbook_excerpt.txt
